task_summary: The customer wants to return the defective SoundMax Wireless Headphones from order ORD-6011 and receive a refund to the original payment method. The agent must apply the return policy, preview the return details, get the customer's confirmation, and process the refund.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the return policy before using process_return.
Agent must make a process_return preview tool call for ITEM-9075 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true process_return tool call.
Agent must process the item with return reason defective.

opening_message: I need to return my SoundMax Wireless Headphones from order ORD-6011 because they are defective. Please process the return to my original payment method.
